entries.title: Frostwood Return

summary.short: Bin reaches Haven's edge and the town starts reacting to the rumor that he is alive.
summary.default: Bin reaches the Frostwood road, takes the gate route by default, and the return becomes public.

syncSummary: Rumor update: Bin was seen alive on the Frostwood road.
Hub mood shift: Frostbitten moves from anxious to uneasy relief.
Branch flag set: the chosen return route gates 1.1.a or 1.1.b.

entries.title: Bent Pine Patrol

summary.short: Bin and Peri test the Bent Pine line before Haven can settle.
summary.default: The patrol reaches Watch Ridge and confirms the route is not safe yet.

syncSummary: Quest follow-up: Watch Ridge Cleanup can open from the patrol report.
Hub problem: Something is stalking the patrol line up close.

entries.title: Frosted Mug Whispers

summary.short: Bin slips into the Frosted Mug and hears the town's version of his disappearance.
summary.default: The tavern crowd is rattled, the cellar has been talking, and one regular knows more than they should.

syncSummary: Rumor: someone outside town has been buying questions about Garr's family.
Hub problem: quiet fear in the Frosted Mug.

entries.title: Watch Ridge Cleanup

summary.short: Bin reports the patrol result at the gate and the town picks a response.
summary.default: Frostbitten files Bin under 'returned' and the Bent Pine threat gets a name.

syncSummary: Quest progressed: Watch Ridge Cleanup objective filed.
Hub mood shift: Frostbitten moves toward working calm.

entries.title: Inside Track

summary.short: Bin follows the cellar trail and turns gossip into a usable lead.
summary.default: The Mug cellar yields a name, a courier route, and a quiet alliance with the host.

syncSummary: Hub problem: outside buyer of inquiries has a delivery route.
Rumor: the courier uses the south gate on market days.

entries.title: Frostbitten Town Meeting

summary.short: Both routes meet at the Frostbitten town meeting and the arc decides what to act on next.
summary.default: Frostbitten merges the patrol problem and the outside-buyer problem into one practical agenda.

syncSummary: Town agenda set: Bent Pine and the outside buyer are now one combined plan.
Hub mood shift: Frostbitten reaches measured concern.

entries.title: Pre-Chimera Prep

summary.short: Bin spends the day before the move setting his house, the patrol, and the courier in their right places.
summary.default: The town's agenda from 1.3.a becomes one day of real preparation: family location, pre-hunt kit, and the opening move chosen and locked in.

nextCandidates: 1.5 Joint Hunt at Bent Pine (in update)
1.5 Quiet Watch at South Gate (in update — alt branch from fortify)
syncSummary: Family location set: hut, captain's house, or Mug upper room.
Pre-hunt kit picked up at smith or apothecary.
Opening move locked in for the chosen agenda.
